shortDescription: Stay worry-free with GE Profile™ 4-Burner Induction Cooktop that automatically detects your cookware, so when it's removed the burner automatically switches off. The smooth glass surface makes cleaning up messes simpler than ever on this easy clean induction cooktop. This model is both energy star certified and ADA compliant.

features.text: Using induction technology and slide touch controls allows burners to quickly adjust and respond, giving you faster heat and total control.
Intensifies one burner’s heat by redirecting power from others, so you can boil, sauté, reduce, brown, and char quickly.
This induction cooktop detects when your cookware is removed from the cooking surface and automatically shuts off the active burner, helping you stay worry free.
Control two burners as one to create a single cooking surface for larger pans and griddles.
A smooth glass surface makes cleaning up messes simpler than ever on this easy-clean induction cooktop.
Help coordinate meal preparation and cooking with a convenient kitchen timer.
